nfe565ee344.headline: Shift in Europe beckons as Germany's Merz eyes election victory
nfe565ee344.summary: Germany heads to the polls in ten days, with conservative leader Friedrich Merz widely expected to replace Olaf Scholz as chancellor amid a second consecutive year of economic contraction.
nfe565ee344.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and its government's fiscal and industrial policy shapes European growth and markets.

n58eaf2a154.headline: Johannesburg power outages: Brace for a week of planned cuts in these 39 areas
n58eaf2a154.summary: Johannesburg's planned power cuts next week will last eight hours in some affected areas, covering 39 areas in the city.
n58eaf2a154.why: Recurring power cuts in South Africa disrupt businesses and industrial output, and reflect strain on the national grid.

n83b2649a8b.headline: Masala Miliband - Energy Secretary seeks closer India ties on clean power
n83b2649a8b.summary: UK Energy Secretary Ed Miliband is in India encouraging deals for renewable power assets as both countries pursue closer clean energy ties.
n83b2649a8b.why: Renewable power deals create investment opportunities for developers, utilities and equipment suppliers in cross-border energy markets.

nfd18024961.headline: Ringgit ends higher after correcting oversold position
nfd18024961.summary: The ringgit ended higher against the US dollar as the local currency corrected from an oversold position.
nfd18024961.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect import costs, foreign investment returns and regional currency sentiment.

n70b4d51e62.headline: Eskom to disconnect 15 Free State towns over billions worth of debt
n70b4d51e62.summary: Eskom plans to disconnect 15 Free State towns over billions of rand in debt. Four municipalities have two months to convince the utility not to switch off their electricity.
n70b4d51e62.why: Eskom is South Africa's state-owned electricity utility, and municipal arrears are a major driver of its financial strain. Collections and disconnections affect the utility's finances and the country's power sector.

n2014f2e387.headline: Russia's defence spending exceeds that of Europe, study finds
n2014f2e387.summary: A study finds Russia's military spending is growing so fast that it exceeds that of Europe, despite European efforts to increase budgets and rearm. The comparison highlights shifting defence spending balances.
n2014f2e387.why: Defence budgets drive demand for industrial output and shape government borrowing and geopolitical risk premiums.

nd527bc7838.headline: Importers expect end to double-handling charges as Lagos-Ibadan cargo train resumes
nd527bc7838.summary: Importers expect an end to double-handling charges as the Lagos-Ibadan cargo train resumes operations in Nigeria.
nd527bc7838.why: Rail freight reduces logistics costs and transit times for importers, which affects trade competitiveness and port-to-inland supply chains.

nc568861159.headline: Leonardo exec floats Eurofighter as stepstone for Saudi GCAP entrance
nc568861159.summary: Saudi Arabia could gain industrial know-how for the GCAP fighter program by creating assembly lines for NH90 helicopters and Eurofighters, a Leonardo executive suggested.
nc568861159.why: Leonardo is a major European defence contractor, and fighter programme partnerships shape long-term aerospace and defence orders.

nca9cefa1f3.headline: Pakistan, Turkiye pledge to achieve $5bn bilateral trade target
nca9cefa1f3.summary: Pakistan's PM Shehbaz said there is a 'long way to go' toward the $5 billion trade target, while President Zardari said Pakistan wants more Turkish business investment.
nca9cefa1f3.why: Bilateral trade and foreign direct investment between emerging and regional economies shape export growth and capital flows.

nfcba266f35.headline: climate finance eludes Malawi
nfcba266f35.summary: A new ActionAid report says Malawi and 53 other low- and lower-middle income countries are trapped in a debt crisis that has forced cuts to public services and climate action.
nfcba266f35.why: Sovereign debt distress affects government spending, bond yields and the ability of frontier economies to attract investment.

n63ba8840f9.headline: RECORDATI: PRELIMINARY RESULTS FOR FULL YEAR 2024 REVENUE +12.4%, EBITDA(1) +12.5%, ADJUSTED NET INCOME(2) +8.4% PEAK YEAR SALES TARGETS RAISED FOR KEY RARE DISEASES PRODUCTS
n63ba8840f9.summary: Recordati's preliminary 2024 results show revenue up 12.4%, EBITDA up 12.5% and adjusted net income up 8.4%. The company raised peak-year sales targets for key rare disease products.
n63ba8840f9.why: Recordati is an Italy-based pharmaceutical company focused on rare diseases and specialty medicines. Its results and sales targets guide investor expectations for the sector.

n2d50124613.headline: FG moves to increase UBEC allocation from 2 to 5 per cent
n2d50124613.summary: The federal government is moving to increase the UBEC allocation from 2 to 5 per cent. UBEC is the agency that manages basic education funding.
n2d50124613.why: Allocation changes shift public funds toward basic education and affect government spending priorities.

nc3c3a4c0d7.headline: Rachel Reeves vows not to accept an ‘economy that has failed working people’
nc3c3a4c0d7.summary: The Office for National Statistics reported 0.1% GDP growth in the fourth quarter, with a recovery in services. Chancellor Rachel Reeves said she would not accept an economy that has failed working people.
nc3c3a4c0d7.why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of economic activity and shapes expectations for UK interest rates, gilt yields and sterling. Services make up most of the UK economy.

n42cda10df7.headline: Moncler raises profit and revenue in 2024; up dividend
n42cda10df7.summary: Moncler reported 2024 group net income of EUR639.6 million, up 5.0 percent from EUR611.9 million, and its board approved a higher dividend.
n42cda10df7.why: Moncler is an Italian luxury outerwear brand, and its annual results signal demand for premium fashion.

impacts.why: Full-year results showed higher net income and a higher dividend payout.

nfdb9d9e110.headline: Brava Energia Signs Supply Deal with Trafigura for Atlanta Oil
nfdb9d9e110.summary: Brazilian oil firm Brava Energia signed a contract with Trafigura to sell oil from the Atlanta field offshore Brazil.
nfdb9d9e110.why: Brava is an independent Brazilian oil producer, and Trafigura is a major global commodity trading house.

n24c8358d01.headline: Brazil worsens GDP, inflation outlook but remains more optimistic than market
n24c8358d01.summary: Brazil's government cut its 2025 economic growth forecast to 2.3% amid ongoing monetary tightening and raised its inflation outlook. The forecast remains more optimistic than the market's view.
n24c8358d01.why: Brazil's growth and inflation trajectory shapes central bank policy, the real currency and returns on Brazilian equities and bonds.

n515e3fbdd4.headline: Naira strengthens against dollar at black market
n515e3fbdd4.summary: The naira recorded its first appreciation against the dollar at the parallel foreign exchange market since the start of the week. The gain was reported on the black market.
n515e3fbdd4.why: The naira is Nigeria's currency, and parallel-market rates signal pressure on official forex availability and on import costs.

n4222516a57.headline: Australia rejects 'killing' the US aluminium market
n4222516a57.summary: Australia has denied exploiting tariff exemptions granted during Trump's first administration. The denial comes despite claims about its aluminium sales to the US.
n4222516a57.why: Aluminium is a key industrial metal, and tariff exemptions determine how competitively exporters can sell into the US market.

necff603307.headline: Local Airline Lament, Says Multiple Charges Affecting Domestic Operators
necff603307.summary: The chairman of United Nigeria Airlines said multiple charges by government agencies in the aviation sector are affecting domestic operators. The input gives no figures on the charges.
necff603307.why: Operating costs and regulatory charges strongly affect airline profitability, and the domestic aviation sector is a key part of Nigeria's transport economy.

n495a837824.headline: Origin bets on gas and batteries to keep the lights on
n495a837824.summary: Origin Energy says it is well placed to benefit from the energy transition as it bets on gas and batteries. The company is a leading Australian energy retailer.
n495a837824.why: Origin Energy is one of Australia's largest electricity and gas retailers. Its strategy affects the country's power supply and wholesale energy prices.

n176efd15f5.headline: Nigerian Lawmakers Approve Tinubu’s $36.4 Billion Budget
n176efd15f5.summary: Nigerian lawmakers approved 54.99 trillion naira ($36.4 billion) in government spending for this year, in response to a late request from President Bola Tinubu.
n176efd15f5.why: Nigeria's budget sets government spending and borrowing needs in Africa's largest economy by population. Budget size affects fiscal deficits, naira assets and Nigerian bond yields.

n1bec2bf72b.headline: Barrick reports 15% growth in gold production in Q4 2024
n1bec2bf72b.summary: Barrick Gold reported that gold production rose 15% and copper production rose 33% in the fourth quarter of 2024 compared with the third quarter.
n1bec2bf72b.why: Barrick is one of the world's largest gold miners, headquartered in Toronto. Its output levels affect gold and copper supply and the company's earnings.

n06bbd42dd9.headline: New ATM charges could push Nigerians back to bank halls - Sani warns CBN
n06bbd42dd9.summary: Former senator Shehu Sani criticised the Central Bank of Nigeria for removing free ATM withdrawals, warning that new charges could push Nigerians back to bank branches.
n06bbd42dd9.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria regulates the country's banks and payment systems. Changes to transaction fees affect bank revenues and consumer payment behaviour.

n0449f8a42f.headline: Elon Musk says ‘scary-smart’ Grok 3 outperforms rival AI chatbots, will release in about two weeks
n0449f8a42f.summary: Elon Musk said the Grok 3 chatbot outperforms rival AI chatbots and would be released in about a week or two. The model is developed by his AI company xAI.
n0449f8a42f.why: Grok is the AI chatbot developed by xAI, Elon Musk's artificial intelligence company, competing with OpenAI, Google and Anthropic in generative AI.

n980e756217.headline: Global stocks mostly surge following Trump-Putin talks
n980e756217.summary: Global shares mostly showed positive movement after US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin began talks aimed at ending the Ukraine war.
n980e756217.why: Global equity indexes reflect investor sentiment across major economies, and geopolitical de-escalation can shift risk appetite across asset classes.
n980e756217.why_moved: Shares rose on the start of Trump-Putin talks to end the Ukraine conflict, which investors may see as lowering geopolitical risk.

n4dbd0be964.headline: Unilever’s ice cream arm set for Amsterdam main listing in blow to London
n4dbd0be964.summary: Unilever's ice cream business, which makes Ben & Jerry's and Magnum, is set for a main listing in Amsterdam, a move the source describes as a blow to London.
n4dbd0be964.why: Unilever is a global consumer goods group, and a demerger of its ice cream arm is part of its turnaround plan.

nd29ff29d35.headline: Exclusive-Buyout firms vie for cybersecurity firm Trend Micro, sources say
nd29ff29d35.summary: Private equity firms Bain Capital, Advent International and EQT are competing to acquire Trend Micro, valued at 1.32 trillion yen, people familiar say. The buyout firms want to take the company private.
nd29ff29d35.why: Trend Micro is a Japanese cybersecurity software company listed in Tokyo. Take-private deals remove a listed company from the stock market and are often priced at a premium to the share price.

n4c046d07ad.headline: Bank Negara issues discussion paper on National Strategy for Financial Literacy 2026-2030, seeks feedback
n4c046d07ad.summary: Bank Negara Malaysia, via the Financial Education Network, has issued a discussion paper on the second National Strategy for Financial Literacy for 2026 to 2030. It is seeking feedback.
n4c046d07ad.why: Bank Negara Malaysia is the country's central bank and regulator of its financial system. Financial literacy strategies aim to improve household financial management and participation in markets.

n0f956bcd4b.headline: Milan stock market positive at start on peace hopes, money on Tim, Leonardo and Unicredit sold
n0f956bcd4b.summary: Piazza Affari opened positive, following a strong Tokyo close and hopes for a Ukraine-Russia peace deal after U.S. involvement. Shares of Tim, Leonardo and UniCredit were sold.
n0f956bcd4b.why: Milan's FTSE MIB is Italy's main benchmark index. Its heavyweights include banks, defence and telecom companies, which are sensitive to geopolitical developments.

n0e38c77b51.headline: Column-Asia moves quickly to replace sanctioned Russian crude oil:  Russell
n0e38c77b51.summary: Asia's crude oil markets are adjusting rapidly to new sanctions against top supplier Russia, with buyers taking cargoes while they can and moving to alternative supplies.
n0e38c77b51.why: Russia is a major crude oil exporter, so sanctions reshape global supply flows and benchmark pricing for oil importers in Asia.

n546abf808a.headline: State Department halts plan to buy $400M worth of armored vehicles from Musk's Tesla
n546abf808a.summary: The State Department had been in talks with Tesla to buy armored electric vehicles, but the Trump administration has put the plans on hold after reports of a potential $400 million purchase.
n546abf808a.why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle maker, and government contracts can be a meaningful revenue source in specialised vehicle segments.

impacts.why: A potential $400 million government vehicle purchase from Tesla has been put on hold.

n7f63d01ab6.headline: Ed Miliband claims 'we're no longer gambling in the fossil fuel casino'
n7f63d01ab6.summary: The UK government has announced another potential £200 million boost to offshore wind developers. Critics called it a baby step in the right direction, according to the report.
n7f63d01ab6.why: Offshore wind is a major part of UK energy policy, and government support affects developer investment and power supply plans.

na0ef09b67b.headline: China hopes new fleet of ‘silver trains’ will encourage its elderly to travel, and spend, more
na0ef09b67b.summary: China will launch special silver trains built for elderly passengers to encourage its ageing population to travel and spend more. The move comes as the country grapples with demographic decline and a stuttering economy.
na0ef09b67b.why: Consumer spending is a key driver of China's economy, and policies targeting older consumers affect the travel and services sectors.

n631803cf59.headline: House sales level off in January but expected to pick up soon – RICS
n631803cf59.summary: Buyer demand and sales activity steadied in January, but housing market professionals expect activity could pick up later in the year, according to RICS.
n631803cf59.why: RICS survey data tracks UK property activity, which feeds into expectations for housing, mortgage lending and the wider economy.

n97e43d5932.headline: Workers at B.C. LifeLabs file 72-hour strike notice over wages, benefits
n97e43d5932.summary: The union representing about 1,200 LifeLabs workers across British Columbia issued a 72-hour strike notice to the employer. The dispute concerns wages and benefits.
n97e43d5932.why: LifeLabs is a major Canadian medical laboratory operator, and labour disputes can disrupt its services and operating costs.

nea3a71c8e8.headline: Petrobras inks agreements with BPCL, OVL, and Oil India
nea3a71c8e8.summary: Brazilian oil company Petrobras signed a strategic term contract with Bharat Petroleum Corporation for the supply of Brazilian crude grades. Agreements with ONGC Videsh and Oil India were also reported.
nea3a71c8e8.why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil producer, and long-term crude supply contracts with Indian refiners shape export flows and offtake commitments.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Signing term supply contracts secures long-term crude offtake for Brazilian grades.

nef1bf3bc7c.headline: ‘Time running out’ for Lilium Aerospace as funding fails to materialise
nef1bf3bc7c.summary: Lilium Aerospace is racing to secure funding and is poised to file for insolvency on 14 February if the promised payment has not arrived. Its short-lived existence depends on the cash.
nef1bf3bc7c.why: Lilium is a German developer of electric vertical take-off aircraft, and its funding gap signals the financial strain facing eVTOL start-ups.

n47f0926b46.headline: Global tech spending to hit USD $4.9 trillion by 2025
n47f0926b46.summary: Forrester forecasts global technology spending will surge to $4.9 trillion by 2025. The growth is driven by advances in software, artificial intelligence and cloud technology.
n47f0926b46.why: Technology spending by businesses drives revenue for software, cloud and IT services providers worldwide.

n2b8bb270de.headline: Oil settles flat, pares early losses as tariffs delayed
n2b8bb270de.summary: Oil prices settled flat on Thursday, paring losses of more than 1% after US tariff announcements were delayed until at least April. Trump ordered officials to study reciprocal tariffs.
n2b8bb270de.why: Crude oil is a globally traded commodity, and trade-war fears can weigh on economic growth and energy demand expectations.

nd8a6494156.headline: Riot Platforms appoints new directors to board with inputs from Starboard, D.E. Shaw
nd8a6494156.summary: Riot Platforms appointed new directors to its board with input from Starboard Value and D.E. Shaw, which both hold positions in the bitcoin miner. Starboard has pushed Riot to consider allotting power capacity to AI.
nd8a6494156.why: Riot is a bitcoin mining company, and activist shareholders can influence capital allocation, including whether power capacity is used for AI or mining.

n12755e8530.headline: US inflation got worse with rising prices on groceries and gasoline
n12755e8530.summary: US inflation accelerated last month as the cost of groceries, gasoline and rents rose, disappointing families and businesses, according to an AP report.
n12755e8530.why: Consumer price inflation shapes Federal Reserve interest-rate policy, which feeds through to bond yields, borrowing costs and equity valuations.

ndc434cb8ab.headline: A far-right party saw a historic surge in support in Germany's election. Here's what to know
ndc434cb8ab.summary: Alternative for Germany surged to its best showing by a far-right party since World War II in the national election and became the strongest political force in parts of the country.
ndc434cb8ab.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, so political shifts affect fiscal policy, energy and industrial policy, and investor sentiment toward euro-area assets.

n5ce5f9757a.headline: Two more IMF missions due in next few weeks
n5ce5f9757a.summary: Two IMF missions are due in the coming weeks, with talks on over $1bn in climate resilience funding and a biannual review of the $7bn Extended Fund Facility.
n5ce5f9757a.why: The IMF programme provides financing and policy conditions that affect Pakistan's fiscal path, reserves and sovereign bond risk. Climate resilience funding is an additional source of external financing.

n764d8994f0.headline: Kakao to launch new AI service with OpenAI this year
n764d8994f0.summary: Kakao Corp. said it plans to launch a new AI-powered service with OpenAI later this year, as the Korean messenger company expands its AI offerings.
n764d8994f0.why: Kakao operates South Korea's dominant messaging platform, and partnerships with leading AI developers shape its growth in digital services.

n3733642ca9.headline: FBR confident of raising tax-to-GDP ratio despite shortfall
n3733642ca9.summary: Pakistan's tax authority is confident of raising the tax-to-GDP ratio, though tax analysts warn the government may miss its collection target by Rs1 trillion.
n3733642ca9.why: The tax-to-GDP ratio measures how much tax revenue an economy generates, and shortfalls affect the budget deficit and fiscal commitments to international lenders.

n87fa434e7e.headline: What Next For Honda And Nissan?
n87fa434e7e.summary: Honda and Nissan announced on Thursday they are scrapping merger talks. The combination would have created the world's third-biggest auto company by unit sales, behind Toyota and Volkswagen.
n87fa434e7e.why: Honda and Nissan are major Japanese automakers, and the planned combination was intended to create scale in a costly, electrifying industry. Shareholders and the Japanese auto sector watch such deals closely.
n87fa434e7e.why_moved: Scrapping the merger ends a planned combination that would have created a major automaker. Investors reassess each company's standalone prospects without the expected scale benefits.

n87dee78501.headline: Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves $ 15.86 billion
n87dee78501.summary: Pakistan's total liquid foreign reserves were US$15,862.6 million as of February 7, according to the Associated Press of Pakistan. The report cites State Bank data.
n87dee78501.why: Liquid foreign reserves measure a country's capacity to pay for imports and service external debt. Investors track them closely when assessing sovereign and currency risk.

n44a146f9fd.headline: Honda’s nine-month profit down year-on-year as it ends talks with Nissan
n44a146f9fd.summary: Honda reported a 7% decline in profit for the nine months ended in December and terminated talks with Nissan. Nissan was reportedly walking away from a merger that would have been a $60 billion deal.
n44a146f9fd.why: Honda and Nissan are major Japanese automakers, and a combination would have created one of the world's largest car groups. Their results and deal activity shape the Japanese auto sector.

n37a5b3faac.headline: Trump singles out Canada’s digital tax amid escalation of trade threats
n37a5b3faac.summary: Trump signed an executive order for reciprocal tariffs on Thursday, and his administration named Canada's digital services tax as a major trade irritant. The order escalates U.S. trade threats.
n37a5b3faac.why: Digital services taxes levied on large technology platforms are a recurring point of friction in trade talks and affect U.S. technology companies operating abroad.
n37a5b3faac.why_moved: A reciprocal tariff order escalates trade threats, raising uncertainty for cross-border trade and for companies exposed to digital taxes.

nc5dfa91353.headline: Implats production falls as challenges mount in PGM market
nc5dfa91353.summary: Impala Platinum’s production fell 4% in six months, despite increased sales volumes, due to market challenges in PGM sector.
nc5dfa91353.why: Platinum group metals are critical for automotive and industrial applications, affecting commodity prices and mining investments.

n61d5ce93e8.headline: Louisiana Rep. Clay Higgins Asks Trump to Put Tariffs on Foreign Seafood
n61d5ce93e8.summary: Louisiana's seafood industry requests tariffs to protect against foreign competition, impacting local economic interests.
n61d5ce93e8.why: Trade policies affecting seafood influence regional economies and export competitiveness.

n414102f1ec.headline: Police Bust Drug Gang in Chiang Mai Seizes Assets Worth 118 Million Baht
n414102f1ec.why: Asset seizures in criminal cases can impact local economic activity and law enforcement funding.

nf0921c14b4.headline: iPhone SE 4 launch on Feb 19? Apple CEO Tim Cook shares cryptic update
nf0921c14b4.summary: Tim Cook announced a product launch date, sparking speculation about a new low-end iPhone model.
nf0921c14b4.why: Product launches from Apple can influence consumer electronics markets and investor sentiment.

nc2ecc5ed28.headline: Zoetis Earnings Top Analysts' Forecasts
nc2ecc5ed28.summary: Zoetis reported better-than-expected Q4 2024 earnings, reflecting strong financial performance amid sector-specific challenges.
nc2ecc5ed28.why: Zoetis is a leading animal health company, and its earnings influence sector sentiment and investor allocations in biotech stocks.
